zh: 一条高而窄的轮廓向上收至尖状区域。
上部附近围出一个小的浅色开口。
左侧以较宽且略不规则的笔画向下延伸。
右侧以较细的近竖向笔画向下延伸。
下端保持开口，未形成闭合底部。
来源元数据预期有两张图，但当前只有一张本地复核图；第二张来源图仍需重新获取。
en: A tall narrow contour rises to a pointed upper region.
A small pale opening is enclosed near the upper part.
The left side descends as a broad, slightly irregular stroke.
The right side descends as a thinner near-vertical stroke.
The lower end remains open rather than forming a closed base.
Source metadata expects two images, but only one local review image is present; the second source image still needs retrieval.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
